prompt: Check for outdated dependencies in this Bun monorepo and upgrade those whose new version was published more than a week ago. Cover all of them: the npm packages of every workspace (`bun outdated -r`), Bun itself (`packageManager` in the root package.json), and the GitHub Actions the workflows in .github/workflows use (`uses:` versions). The ai-*.yml workflows are generated from packages/ai-action-configs/src/workflows.js, so change the versions there and run `bun run --cwd packages/ai-action-configs generate`. Run the lint, format check and tests after upgrading, and leave out any upgrade that breaks them.
